theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+3.31%) and Energy (+1.32%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.50%) and Consumer Staples (-0.34%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.32% versus -0.31% for defensives and +0.48% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.91% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.35%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +1.00%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 10.53% to 17.41, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 1.47% to $3,994.30, crude oil was little changed at $87.24, and bitcoin gained 0.70% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
